sources.snippet: If model uses timm image encoders (convnext, siglip, eva, etc) ensure the latest timm is installed. Upgrade timm if you see 'Unknown model' errors for the image encoder. If model uses transformers tokenizers, ensure transformers is installed. See also this [Clip Colab]. To compute billions of embeddings efficiently, you can use clip-retrieval which has openclip support.

sources.title: SigLIP Models | mlfoundations/open_clip | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides a technical overview of SigLIP (Sigmoid Loss for Image-text Pairs) models within the OpenCLIP framework. It details the specialized SigLipLoss implementation, the SigLIPTask abstraction for training, memory-efficient chunked computation, and the configuration patterns for SigLIP and SigLIP2 variants.
